parameters.help_en: The name of the DataAgent. This parameter is passed in the request path to specify the DataAgent to which the thread belongs

parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the thread to be updated. This parameter is passed in the request path and is returned by the CreateThread operation
parameters.help_zh: 要修改的会话 ID，通过请求路径传入，由 CreateThread 返回
parameters.name: thread_id
